newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-INSIGHT-Silent night in Australian SYCOM bond trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-INSIGHT-Silent night in Australian SYCOM bond trade.

text.p: *Australian bond futures saw little action during afterhours trading, although prices were marginally higher reflecting a firm U.S. Treasury market.
*The December 10-year bond futures contract attempting break back above 92.500 after finding support at around 92.450.

Australian bond futures saw little action during afterhours trading, although prices were marginally higher reflecting a firm U.S. Treasury market. The December 10-year bond futures contract ended SYCOM trade at 92.490 compared with Monday's 92.460 pit finish, but turnover was a mere 429 lots.

The contract is now attempting to break back above the psychological 92.500 level after finding support at just below 92.450, but moves beyond that are expected to be limited to 92.580 at most in what is expected to be a thin pre-Christmas shortened session.
Pit trading ends at 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT) and resumes with SYCOM trading at 8.30 a.m. (2130 GMT) on Friday.
November new motor registrations are due at 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT), although traders said the data rarely moves the market and are likely to pass unnoticed.

U.S. Treasuries firmed in thin turnover supported a fall in the December University of Michigan consumer sentiment index to 96.9 from 99.2 in November. Other data was mixed with November personal income rising a smaller then expected 0.5 percent, while personal spending also rose 0.5 percent compared with an expected 0.3 percent increase.
